narrative:
Allen County has 63,986 registered voters, with 55.3% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 32.0% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 12.7%, a pronounced Republican lean of 19.3 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 28.7% of registrants.
